claims.statement: Late payments create current losses from non-payment, interest, monitoring, collection and legal work; cited EU analysis estimates these costs at about 8% of total costs for micro companies.
SME owners and finance managers experience the cash-flow loss and can fund recovery from collected proceeds, although willingness to share recoveries is unverified.

commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Outcome-based routing across reminder, mediation, legal and financing options differs from fixed debt-collection software.
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own SME marketplace contracts; SMEs retain debtor relationships and collection claims.
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Accountants and bookkeeping platforms refer overdue-invoice portfolios.

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Assumption: 500-1,500 PLN per SME via accountants.
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Success fee deducted when debtor funds clear.
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 35-55% after recovery-partner share and payment costs.
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Automated intake plus exception handling; legal work passed to licensed partners.
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Legal, complaints, AML/payment review and insurance estimated at 15,000 PLN monthly at scale.
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Percentage of cash recovered plus optional monitoring subscription.
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Recovery-partner share, payment processing, data checks and support.

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Collection agencies and invoice platforms may lower fees; neutral routing and accountant distribution are defenses.
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: An invoice becomes overdue, impairing SME liquidity; revenue occurs only when overdue cash is recovered.
commercial_mechanics.payer: Creditor SME through a deduction from recovered proceeds
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Invoice passes 14-30 days overdue and internal reminders fail.
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Each overdue invoice; portfolio-monitoring subscription renews monthly.

contrary_evidence: Many SMEs avoid aggressive collection to preserve customer relationships.
Regulated legal and payment activities cannot be performed casually and require qualified partners.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Unknown; proposed accountant distribution agreements and SME recovery mandates are unsigned.
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Acquire SMEs directly through a free overdue-invoice diagnostic and route only to nonexclusive licensed partners.
critical_control_point.current_owner: Creditor SMEs own claims and debtor relationships; collection partners control regulated recovery capabilities.
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own SME marketplace contracts; SMEs retain debtor relationships and collection claims.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No existing rights to invoices, accountant channels or recovery capacity.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder would control intake, scoring and routing; SMEs decide actions and licensed partners execute regulated steps.
critical_control_point.subject: Overdue-invoice routing transaction

economics.acquisition_route: Partner with one licensed collection firm, test 100 SME invoices through accountants, then add competing recovery routes.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 400M PLN annual claims routed, 15% recovered, 10% gross fee and 45% contribution yields 2.7M PLN contribution; a 70% stake at 4x owner earnings could exceed 5M PLN in years 6-9. Recovery rate and legal scope are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly; partner execution prevents a manual collection job.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Success fees less partner share, payments and direct case support; target 45%.
economics.payback: CAC is paid only from recovery; target platform acquisition payback on the first recovered invoice.
economics.pricing: 8-15% of recovered cash, with higher rates for advanced legal stages.
economics.retention_or_repeat: SMEs generate recurring invoices and periodic delinquencies.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned recovery outcomes improve route and timing selection.
fingerprint.customer: Polish micro and small B2B creditors.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Creditor pays a success fee only when cash is recovered.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Invoice remains unpaid after internal reminders.

founder_fit: Asynchronous accountant channel reduces social load
60,000 PLN test is within available capital
risks: Regulatory boundary around legal and payment services

structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: proposed routing and recovered cash fee rail
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: creditor mandates and licensed recovery partners

thesis: Make the overdue-invoice cash event the control point and charge only on recovery, using data to route each claim to the least destructive effective action.
title: Late-Invoice Recovery Marketplace
uncertainties: Polish recovery rates by invoice segment
